summary: The candidate accepts in writing and lists the agreed pay, title and start date.
realLife: Advice is to send a written acceptance thanking the employer and listing salary, title, start date and any extras. If nothing is heard back, follow up by phone.
sources: UW-Madison SuccessWorks, accepting and negotiating your offer: https://successworks.wisc.edu/accepting-and-negotiating-your-offer/
inGame: Becomes the person's new job record (employer, position, workplace, pay, tenure) in the jobs module when hired; the player-side step is a decision to take the job.

turns.summary: The candidate accepts on a call with nothing in writing.
turns.writesBack: The job record begins, with a risk of misunderstanding about pay or start date.

turns.summary: The employer replies that a term was wrong and fixes the pay or title.
pulledBy: a record of the pay figure
turns.writesBack: The job record starts with the corrected terms, and a trust note is made.

turns.summary: After writing the terms, the candidate calls to back out.
pulledBy: a candidate with a better offer
turns.writesBack: The vacancy reopens, and the employer's tie to the candidate turns cold.
